The image shows a mango leaf with small, round, blister-like raised bumps scattered across the surface — both greenish and darker (brown-black) colored. These are classic galls, visible on the leaf surface with varying colors indicating different ages. No powdery coating, no sunken lesions, no angular bacterial spots, no black sooty coating.

This matches **Gall_Midge** precisely: round blister-shaped galls (~2-3mm), green to brown-black coloration depending on age, visible on leaf surface.
